pages.text: Refined Storage is the primary T3 digital storage and autocrafting system.

$(bold)Dual-path recipes:$(/bold) IridescentCraft adds a dual-path recipe system for RS components. Tech path uses Mekanism/Thermal materials. Magic path uses Botania/Ars Nouveau materials. Hybrid path (both) gives double yield.$(br2)$(bold)T4 upgrade:$(/bold) Advanced RS components (Disk Drives, Pattern Encoders for complex autocrafting) are T4 content. Basic storage is T3.
$(bold)Setup recommendation:$(/bold) Build RS alongside your Mekanism ore processing chain. The autocrafting capability transforms T3 progression speed significantly.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Refined Storage is documented at $(bold)refinedmods.com/refined-storage$(/bold). In-game, JEI covers all crafting recipes. The system is largely intuitive once the Controller and Disk Drive are placed.
